channel.title: Building Our Games
channel.description: Wild Rebellion and Monstrum World: development stories and published updates.

item.title: New adventures, a growing farm, and smoother play
item.description: Episode 4 brings new places to explore, farming gains more depth, and a round of character and control fixes makes the adventure clearer.

item.title: How Lilly’s drawings became a world you can play
item.description: Follow the path from original characters to animated stories, Roblox adventures, and family playtests.

item.title: Building a companion worth coming home to
item.description: How ranch care, exploration, combat, and evolution fit together in Monstrum World.

item.title: A soundtrack for coming home
item.description: Ten new original themes join Go! Go! Monstrum! in an eleven-song ranch playlist.

item.title: A world-boss invitation when you are ready
item.description: Boss prompts now respect your saved recovery time, including when you return to the game.

item.title: A kitchen for the ranch. Clearer choices for your team.
item.description: Juniper’s cooking, better disc rewards, and an interface pass for battles and fusion.

item.title: More reasons to explore, race, and return home
item.description: Distinct home interiors, villain quests, a coin shop, and new parkour goals give the village more to do.

item.title: A clearer view of the adventure
item.description: The v36 update makes room for the world with quieter panels, remembered choices, quest fixes, and a fuller jukebox.
